Definition: from G2596 and G2572; to cover wholly, i.e. veil:--cover, hide.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says a woman who will not cover her head should be shorn, and a man should not cover his, since he is the image and glory of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the covering was about honour in worship, and the honour still matters even when the customs change.
